title: A Morning Walk by the River
paragraphs: Every morning before work, Rania walks along the small river near her neighborhood, a habit she started after a doctor suggested more daily movement to help with her constant back pain.
At first, the walk feels like just another item on her busy to-do list, something to finish quickly before rushing to get ready for the office each morning.
After a few weeks, she notices herself actually looking forward to the walk, paying attention to small details like herons standing still in the shallow water or the changing color of the sky.
Months later, Rania realizes the walk has become less about exercise and more about a quiet moment of calm before her day begins, something she now genuinely looks forward to each morning.
